title: Mitsuru Matsui
name: Mitsuru Matsui
summary: Japanese cryptographer at Mitsubishi Electric known for developing linear cryptanalysis and for work on MISTY, KASUMI and Camellia cipher technology.
whyThisMatters: Linear cryptanalysis became one of the standard general techniques for evaluating block ciphers. Matsui's work helped turn cryptanalysis into an empirical discipline that can expose weaknesses before a primitive becomes infrastructure.

sections.overview:
Linear cryptanalysis

Mitsuru Matsui is a cryptographer at Mitsubishi Electric. Japan's Patent Office describes his development of linear cryptanalysis and his experimental break of the then-U.S. encryption standard DES. Linear and differential cryptanalysis are now foundational approaches for analysing many block ciphers.

Applied cipher design

Mitsubishi Electric's technical publications identify Matsui as a contributor to MISTY, KASUMI and Camellia cipher development. These projects connect basic cryptanalytic research with the design and standardization of cryptography for communications systems.

timeline.event: Publishes the technique known as linear cryptanalysis.
Reports a public experimental cryptanalysis of DES using linear methods.
MISTY1 is designed at Mitsubishi Electric.
Receives the RSA Conference Award for Excellence in Mathematics.
